integrity: Algebraic branch induction proves exact infinite cycling; exact rational intervals verify active branches, unstable eigenvalues, and contracting primal factors; an explicit stable-preimage curve rules out all-directions repulsion.
scientific_limitations: Original 2023 adaPGM on a scalar strongly convex quadratic, exact arithmetic and specially selected valid initial steps.
Only the indicated strict branch itineraries are classified, not all cycles or typical behavior.
Return multipliers are one zero and one below minus one; the cycles are unstable saddle-type periodic points, NOT repellers in every direction.
Unindexed exact periodic solutions may predate these formulas; priority is not absolute.
title: Exact coexisting prime-two and prime-three adaPGM stepsize cycles with saddle-type local instability
